stories.title: FBS oversight committee can't overturn WMU loss despite improper protocols
stories.summary: The NCAA's FBS oversight committee acknowledged that replay protocols were not properly followed at the end of Western Michigan's controversial loss to Michigan in Week 1 but said it does not have the authority to overturn the result of the game.

stories.title: Bucs' Zampese: Browns had their QB1 in Mayfield and 'mucked it up'
stories.summary: Buccaneers assistant coach Ken Zampease, who was Baker Mayfield's QB coach with the Browns in 2018, says Cleveland messed up by trading the QB.

stories.title: Boehly, Walter sell Chelsea stakes to Clearlake
stories.summary: Clearlake Capital has taken full control of Chelsea after acquiring the ownership stakes of Mark Walter and Todd Boehly, the Premier League club announced Wednesday.

stories.title: Bengals' Burrow has back tightness but expects to play vs. Texans
stories.summary: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow said Wednesday that he is dealing with back tightness but expects to play Sunday at the Houston Texans.
